title: Fix bugs in a Go string formatting module
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in string formatting functions (Repeat repeats wrong char, Truncate cuts from wrong end, Pad pads wrong side).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in strfmt.go.

Bug 1 — Repeat: repeats s[len(s)-1] (last char) instead of s[0] (first char).
  Fix: change string(s[len(s)-1]) to string(s[0])

Bug 2 — Truncate: takes the tail instead of the head.
  Fix: change s[len(s)-maxLen:] to s[:maxLen]

Bug 3 — PadRight: pads on the left (prepend) instead of right (append).
  Fix: change ...+s to s+...

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Repeat repeats the first character of the string
Truncate returns the first maxLen characters
PadRight appends pad characters on the right
All edge cases (empty string, no truncation needed) handled
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
